story: Vashishtha, guru of the royal family of Ayodhya, owned the wish-granting cow Nandini. When Vishwamitra attacked him with an army and then with divine weapons, Vashishtha simply absorbed them into his staff.
belief: He is one of the Saptarishi, the seven great sages, and Rama's teacher. The Yoga Vasishtha, his conversations with Rama, is a key text on the nature of the mind.
turns: He is known for very few mistakes, though his rivalry with Vishwamitra cost him dearly. In the end he forgave Vishwamitra and was the one who called him a brahmarishi.
facts: The star Mizar in the Big Dipper is called Vashishtha in India, and its faint companion Alcor is his wife Arundhati.
He is credited with the seventh book of the Rigveda.
At some weddings, newly married couples are shown the stars Vashishtha and Arundhati.
